title: Trade Desk, Inc. 8-K Filing — Departure of Director
summary: The Trade Desk, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 6, 2026, disclosing that board member Lise J. Buyer resigned from the board effective April 3, 2026. The resignation was not the result of any disagreement with the company's operations, policies, or practices. Buyer had served on the board since March 2019.
